generated_query: I’m a sales director at a mid-market SaaS company, and our Q3 ends in four weeks. Our current pipeline has 12 deals totaling $1.2M, with probabilities ranging from 10% to 95%. I need a three-scenario forecast: a commit number (deals >80% probability), a best-case number (50–80%), and a pipeline view (below 50%). Also, pull our historical close rates for each probability bucket from the last two quarters so I can see if we’re being too optimistic. Then flag any deals that are showing signs of slippage (e.g., stalled stages, extended close dates) and recommend which two or three accounts I should personally intervene on this week. Can you build that analysis in a clean, shareable format?

edit_instructions.target_text: Build accurate forecasts with multiple scenarios, track accuracy, and identify improvement opportunities.
edit_instructions.rationale: Without instruction to build multiple scenarios and track accuracy, the skill cannot produce the three-scenario forecast or pull historical close rates as requested.
